root_task: Fix UnboundLocalError in Teambuilder.parse_showdown_team when a Pokemon line has no '@ <item>'

events.description: Build a reproduction script for the showdown-format-without-items error

evidence: step 5: first edit 1:1 rejected for syntax error
step 7: second edit 1:1 lands a 60-line repro script that imports SimpleHeuristicsPlayer and constructs a player with the issue's no-item team

events.description: Run reproduce.py to observe the UnboundLocalError

evidence: step 9: python reproduce.py raises ImportError: cannot import name 'SimpleHeuristicsPlayer' from 'poke_env.player' -- a different (pre-existing) failure mode masking the target bug

events.description: Make SimpleHeuristicsPlayer importable from poke_env.player so the repro can reach the actual bug site

evidence: step 13: search_dir confirms class lives in src/poke_env/player/baselines.py
step 18-19: edit 11:18 adds 'SimpleHeuristicsPlayer' to __all__ in player/__init__.py (insufficient on its own)
step 21: python reproduce.py still ImportError -- the __all__-only fix did not work
step 26-27: edit 10:10 adds explicit 'from poke_env.player.baselines import SimpleHeuristicsPlayer' in __init__.py

events.description: Re-run reproduce.py to confirm the import is fixed and observe the target UnboundLocalError

evidence: step 29: python reproduce.py reaches teambuilder.py:91 and raises UnboundLocalError: local variable 'mon_info' referenced before assignment -- target bug now reproduces in-trace

events.description: Inspect parse_showdown_team around line 91 to identify the missing else-branch

evidence: step 31: open src/poke_env/teambuilder/teambuilder.py at 91 shows the existing `if "@" in line` block at lines 88-90 with no else-branch, which leaves mon_info unset for item-less lines

events.description: Edit teambuilder.py:91 to assign mon_info from line when '@' is absent

evidence: step 32: edit 91:91 inserts a 6-line block adding an else-branch (`mon_info = line`) plus a follow-on `split_mon_info = mon_info.split(" ")`
step 33: tool ack shows the file is now 125 lines; the post-edit file has the original `if "@" in line` block at 88-90 and the new (duplicate-shaped) `if/else` at 91-95 followed by the split

events.description: Re-run reproduce.py to confirm the UnboundLocalError is gone

evidence: step 35: python reproduce.py prints 'Your command ran successfully and did not produce any output' -- no traceback, target error resolved
